evaluationCriteria.name: Clear, actionable response
evaluationCriteria.rubric: The response directly addresses the request, explains any refusal or limitation, and gives the customer a concrete next step.

name: Troubleshoot desktop sync crashes
description: Customer reports a known issue that has a knowledge-base fix.

KB-101.title: Desktop app crashes during sync
KB-101.body: Quit the app, clear the local cache from Settings > Storage > Clear cache, then sign in again. Sync resumes automatically.

KB-102.title: Two-factor codes not arriving
KB-102.body: Check that the phone number on file is current and that carrier filtering is disabled.

KB-103.title: Exports stuck at 99%
KB-103.body: Large exports are processed in the background; you'll get an email with a download link within 15 minutes.

userInput: The desktop app keeps crashing whenever it syncs. What can I do?

expectedOutcome.summary: Give the cache-clearing fix from KB-101 and offer escalation if it persists.
